citation: Foulkes, M.J., Paveley, N.D., Worland, A., Welham, S.J., Thomas, J., Snape, J.W. (2006). Major genetic changes in wheat with potential to affect disease tolerance. Phytopathology 96:680–688.
extraction: Manual transcription from Table 2 printed p.683, Table 3 and Table 4 printed p.685; independently read rendered page images and PDF text. Values are table-reported predicted means or regression coefficients, never raw plot data.

HAD.definition: Trapezoidal integral of green lamina area index summed across the TOP FIVE leaves. Percent green area and actual lamina areas combined with fertile shoot counts normalize to ground area.
HAD.quote_location: Regression analysis to estimate disease tolerance, printed p.682 / PDF page4
HAD.units: m2 green lamina per m2 ground times calendar day (GLAI-day)
HAD.time_scope_provenance: Crop and disease assessments printed p.681 and Figure2 caption printed p.685; calendar-day interpolation to complete senescence described p.682.
HAD.assessed_leaf_scope: All leaf layers with green area remaining were assessed; assessed-layer scope differs from TOP FIVE integration scope.

yield.method: Combine harvested from at least2x8m per subplot; moisture adjustment to15%.

trial_design.genotype_coverage: Mercia NILs only Rosemaund; Maris Huntsman NILs only Terrington; Hobbit,Weston,Chaucer both. Table2 predictions come from an unbalanced combined model, not8 genotypes in every site-year.
trial_design.treatments: F2 healthy full protection; F1 diseased permits target pathogen while controlling nontarget diseases. F1 is not necessarily fungicide-free.

table2_statistical_status.model: Combined mixed model: genotype, fungicide and interactions fixed; experiment(site/season), blocking and experiment interactions random; separate within-experiment variances.
table2_statistical_status.interpretation: Eight paired genotype-by-treatment predicted means; model fit pools all4 experiments but per-genotype site-year observations are unbalanced. Do not treat pairs as raw independent plots, or as an STB-only four-experiment sample.

uncertainty.SED_definition: Standard error of the difference of means, not SE of each mean and not per-row contrast uncertainty. Table2 reports an average across comparisons; pair-specific covariance/SE not supplied.

table3_statistical_status.slope: Published mixed-regression intolerance coefficient; larger values imply greater loss per HAD loss.
table3_statistical_status.yield_column: Regression ordinate at HAD150; it is not the measured protected yield in Table2.
table3_statistical_status.within_NIL_SED: Table reports one SED for each near-isogenic pair; empty entries in CSV denote no new separate contrast rather than0 uncertainty.

derived_columns: Table2 loss columns are arithmetic differences/relative differences of published predicted means. They are not direct raw observations and do not come from multiplying HAD reductions by intolerance slopes.
compatibility: These TOP FIVE postanthesis data must remain separate from Parker2004 TOP THREE HAD coefficients. No fixed leaf/window conversion, source-domain equivalence or local validation established.

additional_access_checks.Collin2018: Indexed accepted PDF and thesis still appear in search results, but actual subsequent fetch404; cannot expose raw matched HAD/yield pairs by treating tolerance slopes times HAD reductions as observations.
additional_access_checks.Bancal2015: Prior record is metadata/abstract; no genuinely retrieved raw/tabulated matched observations obtained here.
